pagemap_partition.scope: PTE present+anonymous bits only; no PFN values collected. Every mixed anonymous mapping PTE total must exactly equal smaps Anonymous, with stable GC epoch. This partitions resident anonymous pages by GC range, not by allocation stack or live-object ownership.

scope: Read-only proc memory plus smaps; exact GC heap-section sum must match collector heapsize; stable epoch/count/table required. Only wholly covered mappings assigned to GC; partial overlap remains ambiguous. Outside segments includes GC metadata, thread stacks, QuickJS/native arenas and executable BSS; it is not automatically libc live allocations or a leak. No debugger, code injection, collection, restart or business request.
